obligations.requirement: Acquire and resize/rebind expose only the current valid renderer-neutral surface snapshot and never return or publish a stale generation.
obligations.oracle: Create a distinguishable live surface, acquire it, accept a metrics-only resize with unchanged SurfaceGeneration and newer MetricsGeneration, accept a surface-only rebind with newer SurfaceGeneration and unchanged MetricsGeneration, accept a combined advance, then attempt both-equal, either-regressing, zero-generation, wrong-view, invalid-metrics, and post-loss old-surface cases while comparing exact pre/post state.
obligations.acceptance: Each valid independent-axis replacement is atomic; both-equal/either-regressing and all other invalid/stale cases are typed deterministic rejections with the last valid snapshot unchanged, loss yields no acquired target, and post-loss rebind requires newer SurfaceGeneration.
obligations.evidence_required: Focused G3SurfacePresentation lifecycle transcript and surface-generation evidence JSON.

obligations.requirement: PresentSubmitted and Presented are independently observable states; submission alone never claims presentation.
obligations.oracle: Submit a FrameState that exactly matches the current live surface, inspect the tracker before feedback, then supply exact PlatformQualified Presented feedback and inspect it again.
obligations.acceptance: The record is PresentSubmitted before feedback and Presented only after the exact qualifying feedback; identifiers and optional timestamp remain exactly correlated.
obligations.evidence_required: State-transition assertions and presentation-tracker evidence JSON.

obligations.requirement: Feedback from an old surface or metrics generation cannot become Presented after resize/rebind or surface loss.
obligations.oracle: Submit frame A on generation A, advance the live surface to distinguishable generation B or mark it lost, inject A feedback, and compare current presentation state before/after; then submit and qualify frame B.
obligations.acceptance: A feedback has a typed stale disposition and publishes nothing; frame B alone reaches Presented under exact live generations.
obligations.evidence_required: Generation A/B negative and positive lifecycle corpus with unchanged-state assertions.

obligations.requirement: Unknown, mismatched, non-qualified, non-presented, and duplicate feedback cannot advance the wrong frame or manufacture Presented.
obligations.oracle: Exercise wrong ViewId/FrameId, metrics/surface mismatch, Approximate/None evidence, Dropped/Failed/Unknown outcomes, feedback-before-submit, duplicate qualifying feedback, and two distinguishable in-flight frames.
obligations.acceptance: Every negative case has a deterministic disposition and unchanged presented observation; one exact qualifying feedback advances only its matching record and duplicate feedback is idempotent.
obligations.evidence_required: Complete negative-case inventory and exact pre/post tracker snapshots.

obligations.requirement: G3-06 remains renderer-neutral, does not implement platform hosts/CanonicalVisible/Arc or alter G2 and predecessor G3 contracts, and preserves the locked Headless backend consumer path.
obligations.oracle: Review-owned changed-path/dependency scan plus G3 focused matrix, G3HeadlessSkia with the locked published SDK, RF01/G2 predecessor matrix, and git diff --check.
obligations.acceptance: Only authorized G3-06 Render Core lifecycle paths differ; public headers have no platform/Skia types; all predecessor matrices pass and no forbidden paths change.
obligations.evidence_required: Changed-path inventory, dependency scan, focused/predecessor logs, exact SDK identity, and diff check.
